description: Stop your assistant using stale APIs: the latest docs for any npm, PyPI, crates or Go library, trimmed to your topic. ★ One of our best tools. Up-to-date docs for any npm, PyPI, crates or Go library, trimmed for a coding agent's context: finds the project's own llms.txt and docs pages (or the latest release's README), keeps the sections relevant to your topic, within a token budget, with sources and the current version. Stops agents using stale APIs. Use before writing code against a library, to read its current docs on a topic. Instead, use `docs-answer` ($0.02) for a direct answer to one question; `docs-find` ($0.003) for docs locations only. Answers may be cached for up to 6 hours. Price: $0.005 USDC per call (x402 or prepaid credits); failed calls are free. In the free trial.
